pages.brief: Pip the sparrow sitting on the rim of a window box full of plants, looking down.
Pip the sparrow hopping down to pick up a small round seed lying on soil in a window box.
Pip the sparrow following a scattered trail of small round seeds along the edge of a window box.
Pip the sparrow pecking curiously at one more small round seed at the end of a trail.
Pip the sparrow arriving at a large plant pot at the end of a seed trail, sitting on its rim.
Moss the hedgehog revealed curled up behind a plant pot, surrounded by dropped seeds, looking sheepish.
Pip the sparrow and Moss the hedgehog settled together beside a pot, both dozing contentedly.
